description: exp17 cross-cloud provider-balanced pilot. Registry used by run_exp15_ablation --pass N (arm-name validation + args.arms default). Generation is done by scripts/run_exp17_crosscloud.py (not by pass_g); ids come from retrieval_ids.json, not exp11.
name: exp17 provider-balanced vs baseline retrieval (cross-cloud comparative)
context_source: exp17 retrieval_ids.json (same hybrid pool; baseline top-5 vs provider-balanced top-5)

baseline.hypothesis: exp13 exp_off equivalent: rerank(hybrid pool)[:5], provider-imbalanced (2/25 cover all wanted providers).

balanced.hypothesis: ceil(5/|P|) per wanted provider from the SAME reranked pool -> covers all providers. Tests whether fixing content-selection (coverage) raises comparative faithfulness where lexical expansion (exp13) and prompt anchoring (exp16) did not.
